# Fallout 76 plans in 2024: Map expansion in Shenandoah National Park, new seasonal events, new rewards

![Fallout 76 Plans in 2024: Map Expansion to Shenandoah National Park, New Seasonal Events, New Rewards](/uploads/276_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

There is interesting news about the future of Fallout 76 next year 2024!

Art director Jonathan Rush published an open letter to the community yesterday, previewing upcoming expansions.

## 17 million Fallout 76 players

Last month, Fallout 76 just celebrated its 5th birthday and as of this date and the current Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise update, 17 million players have experienced the journey to the wasteland of Appalachia.

## Atlantic City: Part 2 "America's Playground" will be released in spring 2024

In this Atlantic City update there will be a new expedition in which players will face the new enemy "Jersey Devil". There will also be new story-driven quests and lots of rewards.

![Jersey Devil](/uploads/nukaknights-jersey-devil.jpg) 

According to the current status of the PTS, we will also receive the new "Muni" armor as rewards in the quests, not in the new expedition. A third The PITT Expedition can also be seen in the game files, but we will see whether this will also be released with this update or perhaps later.

## Maps expansion south into Shenandoah National Park

![Fallout 76 map expansion south into Shenandoah National Park](/uploads/f76-2024-map-expansion-concept-art.jpg) 

Concept art in high resolution: download here.

This concept art image teases the card expansion. It is possible that you can already see some hints of upcoming content here.

The first thing you notice is the Vault 63 door, which appears to be lying on glowing ground on the left side. Now can we explore Vault 63? Is there a story or settlement there? We'll see.

![](/uploads/fo76-2024-map-expansion-concept-art-details-4.jpg)

And what do we see here in the middle? A building is struck by a red bolt of lightning from the eye of the storm. Has a similarity to the blue laser beams of alien attacks, but it could also have a mystical origin. Do you have any ideas about this?

![](/uploads/fo76-2024-map-expansion-concept-art-details-1.jpg)

This settlement looks like blood eagles. But it is also possible that it is the headquarters of a new faction that awaits us in Shenandoah.

![](/uploads/fo76-2024-map-expansion-concept-art-details-2.jpg)

Then there are e.g. this watchtower, or maybe it's a lookout tower.

![](/uploads/fo76-2024-map-expansion-concept-art-details-3.jpg)

Here you can see a kind of lumberjack camp by a river. This may also be a camp of a faction.

![](/uploads/fo76-2024-map-expansion-concept-art-details-6.jpg)

## Seasonal events and rewards

Throughout the coming year, the team will also increase the spotlight on Fallout 76's popular seasonal events. We look forward to holding them more frequently and offering a variety of new rewards with each event. There are also plans for new seasonal events to round out our offering - so get ready to mark some dates on your 2024 calendars.
